page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top left. Catchword "Hic" at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: deflectitur, singulaque in alia deinceps bina, terna, qua-terna etiā quædam diffecta ramis per totam caveam infinitis expanduntur: columnæ ligneæ triplici ordine faciunt figuram primo sexangulam, deinde nonangulam, postremo sedecangulam. Enimvero celebrata est platanus in lycia, gelidi fontis socia[?] amœnitate itineri opposita, domicilii modo cava L x x x. atque unius pedum spe-cu, nemorofo vertice, & se vastis protegens ramis arborum instar, agros longis obtinens umbris: ac ne quid desit speluncæ imagini, saxa intus crepidinis corona muscosos complexa punices: tam digna miraculo, ut Ficinius Mutianus ter Cons. & nuper provinciæ ejus legatus, prodendum etiam posteris putarit, epulatum intra eam se cum duodevicesimo comite, large ipsa thoros præbente fronde, ab omni afflatu securum, optantem imbrium per folia crepitus, lætiorem quam marmorum nitore, pi-cturæ varietate, laquearium auro, cubuisse in eadem. Atqui martia quercus fontis amœnitate vel umbræ opacitate cosimili, etiam imperatorem hospitem & convivam meruit: Literis enim proditum est imperatorem Frederi-cum cum filio Maximiliano anno 1474, umbra nostræ quercus tam patulis diffusę ramis delectatum, sub ea cum toto imperiali comitatu cœnavisse: ut quanto major est imperator consule, tanto sampetrea quercus lycia platano gloriosior habeatur. Itaque Martis Lucus omnibus civibus communis est, sed præcipue doctis & literatis dicatus. Dic igitur P. Virgili, dic carminibus tuis laudes viridarii nostri

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout (e.g. "eft" as est, "fe" as se, "Conf." as Cons.). Ligatures ct and ft are read as ct and st. Uncertain: "socia" (the word after "fontis" is faint; it could also be read differently), "sampetrea" (the first letter is unclear, may be "fampetrea" in print). The "L x x x." figure is printed in spaced lowercase-looking capitals and is copied as seen. "præbente" is read from a faint ligature. Printing errors left as printed: none clearly visible.
